Super Creek's slump continued. The public 
began to gossip that she couldn't run in 
races because of her Trainer.

Expressing dissatisfaction, Super Creek 
tried to head into training to overturn 
that assessment, only to end up falling 
ill.

Seeing her condition, the Trainer realized 
that her slump was caused by pushing 
herself too hard "for someone else's 
sake."
